description: OOMKill causing 5xx errors in API service

alert.title: High 5xx Error Rate on api-service
alert.description: 5xx error rate exceeded 10% threshold for api-service. Current rate: 35%. Started at 14:30 UTC.

holmes_analysis: Datadog logs show a 5x spike in 5xx errors starting at 14:32 UTC. Kubernetes pod api-service-7b8c was OOMKilled at 14:30 UTC. Memory usage ramped from 512Mi to 2Gi over 10 minutes.

alert.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhausted
alert.description: Active connections reached max_connections (100). New connections are being refused. Affecting payment-service and order-service.

holmes_analysis: PostgreSQL active connections at 100/100. payment-service holds 45 connections (normally 15). order-service holds 30. A long-running query on payments table has been running for 47 minutes, blocking connection releases.

holmes_tool_calls.result: Connection refused errors from payment-service at 09:12 UTC

description: SSL certificate expiry causing service unavailability

alert.title: SSL Certificate Expired for checkout.example.com
alert.description: SSL certificate for checkout.example.com expired 2 hours ago. Users receiving ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID. Revenue impact detected.

holmes_analysis: SSL certificate for checkout.example.com expired at 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z. cert-manager logs show renewal failure: ACME challenge failed due to DNS misconfiguration. Let's Encrypt rate limit hit 3 days ago.

holmes_tool_calls.result: ACME challenge failed: DNS TXT record not found

alert.title: Deployment Rollout Stuck — user-service
alert.description: Deployment user-service-v2.3.1 stuck at 1/3 replicas ready. New pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Old pods still serving traffic via rollout strategy.

holmes_analysis: New pods for user-service-v2.3.1 crash on startup with 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named redis'. The Docker image was built without the redis dependency. Previous version user-service-v2.3.0 still serving traffic (3/3 ready).

description: Kafka consumer lag causing delayed order processing

alert.title: Kafka Consumer Lag Exceeds Threshold
alert.description: Consumer group order-processor lag on topic orders.created exceeded 50,000 messages. Current lag: 127,000. Processing delay estimated at 45 minutes.

holmes_analysis: Consumer group order-processor has 3 consumers but topic has 12 partitions. Consumer throughput dropped from 5000/s to 800/s at 15:30 UTC. GC pauses averaging 2.5s on order-processor pods. Heap usage at 95%.
